meta.title: Fiji — Key Statistics
meta.subtitle: A service- and tourism-led Pacific economy with broad connectivity and natural assets, but persistent poverty, high public debt, import dependence and major exposure to climate hazards.

social.title: SOCIAL
social.strap: Fiji combines broad household connectivity and basic-service access with persistent poverty, water-supply reliability pressures and a heavy non-communicable disease burden.

economic.title: ECONOMIC
economic.strap: Fiji's economy is led by services and tourism. Strong service exports help offset a large merchandise trade deficit, while elevated government debt limits fiscal room to absorb future shocks.

environment.title: ENVIRONMENTAL
environment.strap: Fiji has substantial forest and renewable-energy assets, but coastal settlement and past cyclone losses show how directly climate hazards affect communities, infrastructure and the economy.
